titulo: As insults fly around trade, negotiators for Canada and the U.S. avoid getting personal in public
cuerpo: Politicians from Canada and the U.S. have thrown varying degrees of personal insults back and forth across the border this week, but the two governments' trade negotiators avoided getting personal — at least in public. Experts believe the two trade leads are striking a different tone because they have a different role to play as the dispute heats up.
